verdict.rationale: Flagright documents a transaction verify endpoint that takes the transaction payload, and it markets real-time transaction monitoring, so screening a payment before release is supported. Rule instances run checks on transactions, and alert and alert-hit endpoints suggest a way to inspect results. However, the evidence never shows the verify response containing a decision (e.g. allow/block) or the matched rules and hits tied to a specific transaction. missing for 10: documented decision/action fields in the verify response, explicit per-transaction rule-hit or watchlist-match details, a documented hold-before-release flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can screen a payment before release and inspect the decision and its supporting matches

citations.quote: In order to pass the payload of a transaction to Flagright and verify the transaction, you will need to call this endpoint with the transaction payload.
